about: * This product is an upgrade aimed at customers who have purchased the Digital standard edition of VALKYRIE ELYSIUM *This product contains content for both the PS4™ and PS5™ versions.
*This product also includes content that is sold separately.Please be aware of duplicate purchases.
*There are also set products containing this product. Please be aware of duplicate purchases.
A set allowing you to purchase the following items, included in the VALKYRIE ELYSIUM - Digital Deluxe Edition: ・Equipment for Valkyrie: ""Svartaljr: Sword of the Underworld Goddess""
The digital edition of ""VALKYRIE PROFILE: LENNETH"" is a port of the PSP® (PlayStation®Portable) version.
summary: Long ago, Ragnarok—the End Times—loomed upon the realms. The All-Father Odin, with the last of his strength, created an emissary of redemption, Valkyrie; her sole task being the salvation of a doomed world.
